jobs.description:
Desert Line Architects is hiring a full-time BIM Architect for healthcare and commercial projects in Riyadh.
Responsibilities:
- Develop and manage Revit architectural models to LOD 350
- Coordinate multidisciplinary models and run clash detection in Navisworks
- Produce construction documentation and shop drawings
- Manage model sharing on BIM 360
Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Architecture
- 4+ years of experience in BIM architecture
- Proficiency in Revit, Navisworks and AutoCAD
- Fluent English; Arabic is a plus
Preferred:
- Knowledge of ISO 19650
- Experience with Dynamo
Benefits: housing allowance, transportation allowance, medical insurance, annual flight ticket.
Apply via our careers page.

Full-time BIM Coordinator, hybrid working (3 days in our Dubai office).
Responsibilities:
- Lead BIM coordination meetings
- Run clash detection and issue tracking in Navisworks and Autodesk Construction Cloud
- Maintain BIM execution plans
Requirements:
- 5+ years of BIM coordination experience
- Revit, Navisworks, Dynamo
- Bachelor's degree in Architecture or Civil Engineering
Preferred:
- Autodesk Certified Professional in Revit

We are looking for a Senior BIM Manager to lead a team of 15 BIM specialists on a major mixed-use tower.
Requirements:
- 12+ years of experience, including 5 years managing BIM teams
- Master's degree in Architecture or Engineering
- PMP certification
- Expert knowledge of ISO 19650 and BIM standards
- Revit, Navisworks, Solibri
- Excellent English

Fully remote, full-time BIM Architect (GMT+2 to GMT+4 time zones).
Responsibilities:
- Revit modeling for residential and interior projects
- Prepare construction documentation
Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience
- Revit and AutoCAD
- Strong English communication

Full-time Interior Designer for luxury villa and residential interior projects in Cairo.
Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience
- 3ds Max, AutoCAD, V-Ray
- Bachelor's degree in Interior Design or Architecture
- Arabic and English
Freelance project: convert AutoCAD drawings of a residential compound into a Revit model at LOD 300. Remote. 3-month project.

6-month contract position for a Landscape Designer on park projects in Jeddah.
Requirements:
- 3+ years of landscape design experience
- AutoCAD, Lumion, SketchUp
- Bachelor's degree in Landscape Architecture

Junior Architect, full-time. Must hold ARB registration and the right to work in the UK. No visa sponsorship available.
Requirements: Revit, AutoCAD, 1-2 years of experience.

Full-time Architectural BIM Specialist.
Responsibilities:
- Develop Revit families and templates
- Support BIM coordination and clash detection
Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience
- Revit, Navisworks, BIM 360
- Bachelor's degree in Architecture
